dedupe_keys.name: nature des routes du reseau routier 2021

description: Nature des routes du réseau routier 2021 is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministère de la transition écologique et solidaire. Ce jeu de données décrit la nature des routes, aussi appelée classe de profil en travers, sur le réseau routier national: il précise s'il s'agit d'une chaussée unique ou de chaussées séparées et indique le nombre de voies. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are profil en travers, reseau national routier, rrn. The portal shows 862 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
